name: synapse-correct-course
description:
Manage significant changes during sprint execution. Use when the user says "correct course" or "propose sprint change"

MANDATORY: Execute when managing significant changes, corrections, or scope shifts during sprint execution.

Trigger immediately for:
  - "correct course"
  - "propose sprint change"
  - sprint correction
  - change sprint scope

DO NOT trigger for:
  - General tasks that align perfectly with the current sprint plan.
  - Simple code modifications or bug fixes.
